author: TanjiBro
quote: One of the most unique surprises in the gaming industry that showcased to players and other game developers what a game can be when it is created with love and passion in mind rather than profits. The music? Incredible. The story? Unique and captivating. The characters? Extremely memorable and impactful. The gameplay? Enaging. Having players control their own dodging and parrying in a turn based combat system is incredibly engaging and satisfying. Lastly, the graphics? Easily one of the most unique looking games of all time, and it is absolutely beautiful. E33 is passion and creativity in the form of a video game and deserves all its flowers.

author: TanjiBro
quote: Easily one of the greatest games of all time. Innovates in what a narrative driven game should be and pushes the rpg genre forward with its deep gameplay that pushes players to be creative. Memorable characters and vast amounts of content throughout the game make it so easy to get lost in the world and never want to leave.

author: TanjiBro
quote:
For GTA 6 to even be mentioned in the GOAT debate is ridiculous. It's barely even good enough to make it game of the year. It's hard carried by its graphics, but the performance and actual content/gameplay in the game is lackluster. I've poured in at least 20 hours and all I can honestly say is I've been bored for almost all of it. The realism is a double edged sword in this game. Yes, the game is beautiful to look at, but besides that everything feels like or is a chore. Why is so much of the opening act spent actually doing chores??? This is supposed to be GTA. What players actually want is to have epic heists and go wild on the streets of vice city. Instead players have to fix a house that they can't access the first chapter and manage a relationship that determines the actions that can be made later. If I wanted to fix my house or manage my relationship I would just live my normal life. This is a supposed to be a video game. It's supposed to take you away from real life and be fun. 
The combat in this game is also clunky, there's a bunch of glitches throughout, and the missions are unoriginal and offer little to no challenge. It's just not a fun experience overall.   Jason is also just boring. No personality. Clearly all the personality went to Lucia, who is kind of annoying. I'm hoping the online mode in this game is fun when it releases, but as of right now I've lost all interest in playing this game.

author: TanjiBro
quote: Everything a remake should be. Improved graphics and quality of life changes while still keeping the spirit of the original intact. Ocarina of Time is one of the greatest games of all time for a reason, and Nintendo has done an amazing job at recreating a beautiful masterpiece for both a new generation and returning fans of this iconic franchise.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
